lead: Anbumani Ramadoss is an Indian politician, born on 9 October 1968 in Tamil Nadu.
As of 2026, he is 57 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has held the office of Member of the 16th Lok Sabha and member of Rajya Sabha.

paras: Anbumani Ramadoss was born on 9 October 1968 in Tamil Nadu, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, S. Ramadoss.

sections.heading: Anbumani Ramadoss — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 16th Lok Sabha (2014–present), member of Rajya Sabha and Minister of Health and Family Welfare (2004–2009). He is affiliated with Pattali Makkal Katchi.
